pages.text: “Buried deep within the earth, storing vitality, awakening energy, and lightening one’s steps.”$(br2)Poria Root Tea is a mildly woody-scented beverage made from dried poria root and sugar. The tea is clear with a pale yellow hue and a smooth taste. Drinking it grants a Speed boost, making travelers move more swiftly.

$(br2)$(br)To prepare Poria Root Tea, $(br)boil two portions of dried poria root with sugar.$(br)It is best consumed during long journeys or when speed is required, making travel easier and more efficient.

Upon drinking Poria Root Tea, travelers gain a Speed boost, increasing their walking and running speed.$(br)This tea is ideal for enhancing mobility during travel.$(br)If JEI is installed, press R while hovering over the icon to view the recipe.
